_composition_contract: #2105/redesign-lane-mode-caps-work-shiptail-pools-enforced (2026-08-29) — this file is one of TWO disjoint lane-policy tables (the other is #1939's config/lane-modes.json, which stays single-ceiling — see the plan's Lockstep §(a) for why the two now legitimately encode DIFFERENT semantics). TWO-POOL LANE axis (v2): each mode carries lanes.{work_base, opportunist, work_ceiling, ship_tail_ceiling} — work_ceiling MUST equal work_base+opportunist (mechanically checked by scripts/check-mode-policy-lane-ceiling-parity.mjs against the plan's Target-state table, the new parity authority). The two doormen (hooks/lane-ceiling-gate.sh and hooks/mode-pin-lane-gate.sh) are INDEPENDENT CONJUNCT PreToolUse gates registered at the same start edges — each refuses on its own predicate over the SAME shared pool-aware membership math (hooks/sole_lane_math.py live_pool_members), so the effective per-pool ceiling any spawn actually experiences is min(pin-ceiling, computed-ceiling) BY CONSTRUCTION (tighten-only). WORK pool roles = planner|plan-review|executor|execution-review; SHIP-TAIL pool role = ship-tail; research is never a lane. Within the WORK pool, work_ceiling is a HARD cap (repeats on re-issue); the work_base->work_ceiling band is a block-once ADVISORY (the opportunist judgment surface); ship_tail_ceiling is a HARD cap with no advisory band. PROVIDER axis: openrouter_dispatch (permitted|forbidden) and the NEW local_dispatch axis (permitted|forbidden, mirroring openrouter_dispatch — authorizes the conservative-mode local-LLM offload option, forbidden everywhere else in v1) are pure functions of (this table, the operator pin at ~/.config/cc-mode.json) ALONE. #2189 D2/D3's downstream OpenRouter-credits ONE-WAY veto (can only SUBTRACT permission, never grant it) is unchanged by this redesign. Canonical mode ids are the operator's own words: conservative, normal, boost (renamed from speed-boost — speed-boost is now an ALIAS, never operator-selectable via set-mode, #2189 D6 'aliases may describe, never unlock'); #1939/#2035's spelling token-conservative remains an input ALIAS for conservative. This file never gains a T/nudge-target column — that lives exclusively in #1939's own config/lane-modes.json table, which keeps its own speed-boost vocabulary (resolved via scripts/lane-mode/lib/pin-to-lane-band.mjs's reverse-alias bridge, zero edits needed there). lane_ceiling (the pre-v2 single-number field) is REMOVED — no dual encoding to drift.
